text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 10 units of the B. Braun 500 mL amino acid product (NDC 00264193310) with 2.5 days of supply at current use. Corvale Lakeside holds 30 units with 25.9 days of supply and can spare 13 units while retaining at least two weeks of inventory. Corvale General holds 64 units with 14.6 days of supply and can spare 2 units while retaining at least two weeks of inventory.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include isoleucine, leucine, lysine acetate, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan, valine, cysteine hydrochloride, histidine, tyrosine, n-acetyl-tyrosine, alanine, arginine, proline, serine, glycine, aspartic acid, glutamic acid, and taurine as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal redistribution is the fastest way to extend Corvale East's coverage. Purchasing from an alternate manufacturer is available but not urgent given current network stock.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 13 units from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — raises Corvale East to 6 days of supply; requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Transfer 2 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — raises Corvale East to 3 days of supply; requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
3. Purchase from ICU Medical Inc. (plant listed as OTSUKA ICU MEDCL) — not on FDA's shortage list today; requires buyer execution.

Not recommended: Delaying the Lakeside transfer while awaiting new purchase orders, because Corvale East will remain below one week of supply.
